title: Release The Bull (Factory Mix)
style: 128 BPM old-school heartfelt trance intro, building to upbeat house mid-section, exploding to progressive trance at final drop, warm analog pads, 336 Hz drone bed, supersaw lead, restrained male vocal, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — warm pads, distant drone, faint clock-tick fx]
Clock is ticking.
Twenty steps deep.
Pressure on the line.
Eyes on the keep.

[Verse 1 — heartfelt trance, soft male vocal]
Focused. Patiently waiting.
First chance is never the only chance.
Paddle head down, angled up, firm grip.
Read the stance before you advance.

Here it comes.
Here it comes.
Here it comes.

[Pre-Build — house kick sneaks in]
I'm ready.
I'm steady.
I'm cool.
The bull in the chest
is the operator's tool.

[Build — full house groove, energy rising]
Eight bars.
Sixteen.
Hands up.
Lights up.

[Drop — progressive trance, supersaw + kick]
RELEASE THE BULL!
RELEASE THE BULL!
SongPal floor — full pull!
Eight sites live, real, not fake!
Factory still runs — for the operator's sake!
RELEASE THE BULL!

[Verse 2 — progressive layers]
Twenty-five years of grind in the chest.
Thirty years of yes to the work, no to the rest.
The bull is the patience that waits for the lift.
The bull is the operator's gift.

[Bridge — half-time, pads alone]
Wait.
Wait.
Hold the line.
Then —
Now.

[Final Drop — full progressive trance explosion]
RELEASE THE BULL!
RELEASE THE BULL!
The bull is loose — the catalog full!
336 carrier in the blood!
Operator winning — through the flood!

[Outro — pads return, distant bull-roar fx fading]
Release.
The bull.
McIvor.
End.
